neighbr
  api (backend, hono)
    horses: Horse
      GET /horses
      GET /horses/[id]
      POST /horses
      PATCH /horses/[id]
      DELETE /horses/[id]
      GET /horses/[id]/swipes
      GET /horses/[id]/swiped_by
      GET /horses/[id]/first_matches
      GET /horses/[id]/second_matches
    swipes: Swipe
      GET /swipes
      POST /swipes
    matches: Match
      GET /matches
      GET /matches/[id]
    swipe (endpoint)
      POST /swipe
      steps: record_swipe, match_if_mutual
    candidates (endpoint)
      GET /horses/[horse]/candidates
      steps: pick_candidates
    matches_of (endpoint)
      GET /horses/[horse]/matches
      steps: find_matches
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
    theme: warm
    viewer: Horse from horses, picked on /pick
    nav: bottom, /swipe, /horses, /matches, /me
    /: load horses from horses, Landing, list of HorseCard(horses)
    /pick: load horses from horses, HorsePicker(horses), JoinHerd
    /me: HorseView(viewer)
    /horses: load horses from horses, list of HorseCard(horses)
    /horses/[id]: load horse from horses by id, HorseView(horse)
    /matches: load matches from matches_of as the viewer, list of MatchCard(matches)
    /horses/new: form horses.create, then /horses/[id]
    /horses/[id]/edit: form horses.update, then /horses/[id]
    /swipe: load deck from candidates as the viewer, SwipeDeck(deck)
    Landing: hero
      says: Find your herd. / Swipe on horses near you. Match when it's mutual.
      links to /pick
    HorsePicker(horses: list of Horse): picker
      shows: horses.name, horses.breed
      says: Who are you?
      picks the viewer, then /swipe
    JoinHerd: callout
      says: Not in the herd yet?
      links to /horses/new
    SwipeDeck(deck: list of Horse): deck
      shows: deck.name, deck.age, deck.breed, deck.bio
      says: You've seen every horse. Check back later. / It's a match! / Keep swiping
      calls swipe as the viewer (horse), passing target, liked
    HorseCard(horse: Horse): card
      shows: horse.name, horse.breed, horse.age
      links to /horses/[id]
    HorseView(horse: Horse): detail
      shows: horse.name, horse.handle, horse.breed, horse.age, horse.bio
      opens /horses/[id]/edit
      deletes via horses.delete, then /horses
    MatchCard(match: Match): card
      shows: match.first, match.second, match.matched_at
      match.first links to /horses/[id]
      match.second links to /horses/[id]
  data (3 entities)
    Horse
    Swipe
    Match
